about: pipeline's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests and laws (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: px1-decide-cancels-closed
mutants.rule: A run that ended takes no command, a submit of its name included: Life.ClosedIsFinal.

mutants.name: px1-evolve-drops-pass
mutants.from:
case (Running as r, StagePassed):
		Running{Stages: r.Stages, Next: r.Next + 1}
mutants.rule: A passed stage moves the run to the next one: StagesPassInOrder.

mutants.name: px1-board-two-columns
mutants.rule: A run that moves leaves its old column: BoardIsFoldOfEvents.

mutants.name: px1-board-keeps-retried
mutants.to:
case run.Started:
		Some[Column]{Value: InRun}
	case run.Retried:
		None
mutants.rule: A retried run runs again: BoardIsFoldOfEvents.

mutants.name: px1-retry-gives-up-early
mutants.rule: A stage is tried Attempts times: GivesUpAfterAttempts.

mutants.name: px1-retry-order-number
mutants.rule: Each of the saga's orders names the next try, the third too: GivesUpAfterAttempts (the desk reads the next attempt, not the order, and WaitsItsBackoff sees the first order only, which this mutant keeps right).

mutants.name: px1-retry-timer-half
mutants.rule: The next try is ordered when its whole wait ends: WaitsItsBackoff.

mutants.name: px1-notify-failed-stage
mutants.from: case run.Submitted, run.Started, run.StagePassed, run.StageFailed, run.Retried:
mutants.rule: Only a run that ended gives a notice: OneNoticePerEnd.

mutants.name: px1-flaky-counts-calls
mutants.rule: A runner answers by the try, not by the calls before it: Runner.Repeatable for Flaky.

mutants.name: px1-desk-no-dedupe
mutants.rule: A resend gets the first receipt: ModelTakesEachCommandOnce.

mutants.name: px1-handle-keeps-state
mutants.rule: The step's next state is the fold of its events: SceneAgreesWithStory.

mutants.name: px1-offline-passes
mutants.from: OnFailure: func(u Offline) Signal { Ran{OK: false} }
mutants.to: OnFailure: func(u Offline) Signal { Ran{OK: true} }
mutants.rule: An offline runner is a failed try: SceneAgreesWithStory.

mutants.name: px1-desk-last-first
mutants.rule: Runs start in the order they were submitted: SceneAgreesWithStory.
